Deprecated functions in nowcaster

Fonte: R/deprecated.R
nowcaster-deprecated.Rd

These functions were renamed so that functions used by only one of the workhorse functions end in _inla or _mgcv. They still work but give a deprecation warning and will be removed in a future release.

  • nowcasting_no_age() is now nowcasting_no_age_inla().

  • nowcasting_age() is now nowcasting_age_inla().

Uso

nowcasting_no_age(...)

nowcasting_age(...)

Argumentos

...

Arguments passed to the new function.

Valor

The output of the new function.
